method: Fresh extraction of both workspaces merged into one model at warp-fusion/moju/model. Reactor domains clustered by #[moju(kind, domain, module)] annotations; warp-fusion product domains clustered by crate responsibility (no annotations present except wfusion cli_config). Field names/types are code ground truth.

confidence.high: All struct/state field names and types sourced from extracted facts; reactor domain/module clustering honors #[moju] annotations.
confidence.medium: Flow step sequences and design-level trigger commands (ConfigLoadRequest, IncomingBatch, RunCli, DaemonCommand, GenCommand, ReplayCommand, CheckCommand, ProjectUpdateCommand, ...) inferred from CLI entry points and module responsibilities.
confidence.low: Runtime service composition (warp-fusion/wfgen/wfl/wfadm as services of subsystem WarpFusion); bindings reference external adapters; wfgen vendored wfg_ast treated as the Lang WFG contract.

normalizations: ResolvedSinkSpec / SchemaRef / ConnectorDef -> String (opaque external spec)
AtomicU64 / Mutex / RwLock / VecDeque -> Int / Map / List (container unwrapped)
ExprPlan is a type alias for Expr (plan.rs) -> modeled as Expr
not_modeled: wf-data crate (3 timestamp-normalization helper functions, no types) — infrastructure utility
Internal checker scope/stat plumbing (Scope, StatLabelInfo, FuncCheckCtx, ValType, BindTracking, WindowFieldUsage)
Metrics record internals (MetricsRecord, RegistryLookup) and runtime per-batch debug stats
Receiver batch column builder (ColumnBuilder), RedisBackend, tracing_init structures
Internal hashes/allocators (Fnv1a), test mocks (MockWindowLookup, RuntimeServant, RemoteFixture), EvalTimeScope / StepEvaluationInput plumbing
wfgen vendored wfg_ast copy (WfgFile/ScenarioDecl/... ) — modeled via the Lang domain WFG contract instead of duplicating
naming_decisions: Duplicate YieldField (ast::clauses vs plan) resolved to the plan version (used by YieldPlan)
FanoutSubscription abstracts the private engine Subscription enum (Single/Sharded/RoundRobin)
Reactor modeled with domain-relevant fields only (internal handles/channels omitted)
wfgen vendored wfg_ast types referenced as Lang.* to avoid duplicate WFG AST definitions
Only one target<bin,cli> kept (reactor) — the current parser allows a single anonymous bin target per kind
